svg.title: Shared Neighbor embeddings and transposed Neighbor readout
svg.desc: Full connectivity: shared linear Neighbor embeddings, Rotate90 and sum, 64 pre-RMSNorm Neighbor ReLU residual blocks, final RMSNorm and the shared transposed Neighbor readout. Each RMSNorm is expanded into unary squares, a binary sum tree, a fixed scale and two-parent output multiplications. All nodes have at most two incoming activation links. The first 97 terminal values are answer logits. Every output reaches every a and b token.

g.text: Full connectivity · 128 channels · 32 embedding layers · 64 core layers · 97 answers
54144 neurons · 99263 connections · 32768 unique parameters · all connections shown
S1–S32 are the same weights for a, b and readout. R marks the transposed readout; M marks the ReLU core.
N: pre-RMSNorm with binary trees. M: Neighbor + ReLU with bias. +: residual sum. Final N: RMSNorm before readout. Maximum two incoming links.
All 97 outputs reach all 194 a/b indicators. Left to right; zoom to inspect.
